# Tom Select

The Codeplug Editor's searchable lists (RX and TX tone) use Tom Select, unchanged from its npm release.

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | 2.7.0 (`tom-select-2.7.0.tgz`, npm shasum `87325ad8f308c1bdba3d1b8941171c3a485e4a94`) |
| Files | `dist/js/tom-select.complete.min.js`, `dist/css/tom-select.default.css` |
| License | Apache-2.0 ([LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt](../../../../LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt)) |
| Upstream | https://github.com/orchidjs/tom-select |

To update: download the release tarball from the npm registry, check its shasum against the registry's, copy the
two files over and update this table. The site's colors for it are in `site/static/css/site.css` (`.ts-`).
